# INDEUP

> 인디업(INDEUP)은 공간에 맞춰 가로·깊이·높이를 10mm 단위로 제작하는 대한민국 맞춤형 책상 브랜드입니다. 운영 주체는 스니처이며, 실제 구매는 네이버 브랜드스토어에서 진행됩니다.

## Key facts (verified against src/lib/policy.ts and customFit.ts — do not extrapolate beyond these)
- Warranty: 3 years, no-cost (무상보증 3년)
- Production time: 7-8 business days (excl. weekends/holidays)
- Frame: zinc-plated steel, full welded, powder-coated
- Top: 18mm E0-grade LPM
- Purchase/payment/shipping/exchange: Naver Brand Store only, not this site
- Product lines and their real width ranges: single-desk/floor-desk/side-table/home-bar-table cap at 1300mm max (400mm min, home-bar-table 800mm min); double-desk ranges 1600-2600mm — these are hard caps, not extendable
- Each of single-desk/double-desk ships as two distinct configs — "책상(단품)" (bare top) and "컴퓨터책상" (includes a cable-management mount) — with different minimum depths; treat them as separate products, not interchangeable numbers
